statement: Two coding sessions implemented the 2026-10-07 Mind directive in parallel and wrote different frozen evaluations at the same eight paths. Converge them into one canonical GREG Mind by evidence. Track A restores CI on PR #158 (pinned base at 92bc6e3) and preserves both histories unchanged. Track B builds the converged Mind now in a dedicated draft PR based on the latest verified PR #155 head. Neither session or lineage wins by ownership, recency, code volume or headline counts.
exact_source_excerpt: Execute a provenance-preserving, evidence-driven convergence of both Minds. Restore CI immediately, preserve both original experimental histories, and build one stronger canonical GREG Mind.  I am not selecting either coding session as the winner.
intended_effect: One canonical GREG Mind that is measurably more capable, reliable, comprehensible and maintainable than either lineage alone, with both experimental histories recoverable and every frozen result unaltered.
executable_interpretation: A frozen artifact is identified by (source commit, original path, sha256), and only its original commit is authoritative. Collisions are recorded in a source-location manifest, never resolved by renaming or rewriting. Namespaced copies are labelled byte-identical archival copies. Every conflict gets a disposition: complementary, interchangeable, semantic incompatibility, duplicate, historical evidence, or unresolved architectural decision. Canonical mechanisms are chosen by reproducible tests, adversarial inspection, founder intent, maintenance cost, safety, measured performance and integration fit. Unresolved alternatives stay as isolated, registered, withheld alternatives. There is one cognition entry point, one authority system and one evolution controller. New integrated evaluations are pre-registered and freshly frozen before held-out execution.
canonical_owner: GREG cognition on the existing GREG mission/authority/journal path; the convergence PR is the only place shared live-code conflicts between the lineages are resolved
owner: GREG cognition maintainers; Alfonso remains root human authority
implementation_state: Track A in progress: snapshot branches claude/lineage-snapshot-pr158-7e0daaf and claude/lineage-snapshot-pr155-ba8d990, and pinned base claude/greg-mind-base-92bc6e3 with PR #158 retargeted to it (tag pushes are refused by the proxy, so the SHAs in the manifest carry the identity). Track B not yet started.
binding_scope: Reconciliation of the two Mind lineages; draft PRs, tests and frozen evaluations only.
authority_scope: No merge, deployment, publication, external consequence or authority expansion. Alternative engines never assume live authority.
constitutional_constraints: Frozen evidence is never altered. No rejected P8 configuration is promoted. No NO_GAIN result is presented as lift. Admission stays bound to the exact tested version. Kernel, event spine, authority, shutdown and founder decision boundaries are preserved. Data with unresolved redistribution rights stays out of any release.
success_evidence: both lineages recoverable at their recorded SHAs
every conflict dispositioned in the reconciliation map
integrated branch green on its own CI
fresh pre-registered evaluation showing the converged Mind is at least as strong as each lineage on their own frozen families
failure_evidence: A frozen file renamed or rewritten; a lineage's evidence unrecoverable; two active canonical Minds or evolution controllers; a lineage chosen by ownership or volume; CI on the pinned branch claimed as integration proof.
conflicts: The two lineages' P4 v3, P6 v2, P6 v3, P8 and admission v2 runs share short names but are different evaluations; they are cited by lineage and commit.
next_review_trigger: Convergence PR opened; each pre-registered integrated evaluation; any further write to the other lineage's frozen paths
failure_condition: Either lineage's useful mechanism or evidence is silently discarded, or the convergence expands authority.
next_gate: Track B inventory and file-by-file reconciliation map, then mechanism selection by evidence and the integrated draft PR.
named_skill: Recorded per docs/PROJECT_COGNITION_SOP.md section 5; source preserved verbatim.
